entries.name: Refine Redmond
entries.description: Not a genre: a DPO-refined LoRA meant to improve the overall quality of ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo output (the author reports about 70% wins in blind A/B tests). Use the 4B language model for prompting.
entries.author: artificialguybr

entries.name: Acoustic guitar (fingerstyle)
entries.description: Fingerstyle acoustic guitar, trained on six self-recorded files. The author recommends a low LoRA scale (0.2 to 0.7).
entries.author: DisturbingTheField

entries.name: Ambient Dream
entries.description: Ambient sounds, trained on 10 short instrumental pieces. Works best for pure ambient, less for pop or rock. Put the trigger word in the caption.
entries.author: DisturbingTheField

entries.name: Raspy male vocals
entries.description: A hoarse male singing voice, trained on seven self-recorded files; it also colours the instruments. The author recommends a low LoRA scale (0.2 to 0.7).
entries.author: DisturbingTheField

entries.name: Rock, acoustic and electronic instrumentals
entries.description: Instrumental style trained on 21 self-made tracks (rock, acoustic, ambient, electronic; guitars, bass, drums, piano, synth). The author recommends a low LoRA scale (0.2 to 0.7).
entries.author: DisturbingTheField

entries.name: Chinese New Year
entries.description: Festive Chinese New Year style with a female vocal and folk instruments (bass drum, dizi, erhu), trained on 12 songs. Research and academic use only: commercial use is prohibited. Use the DiT model, not the Think model.
entries.author: ACE-Step
